In this unique B2B role, you will run the monthly reconciliation between a partner's own tracking and the figures reported by operators and other commercial partners. You will pull monthly statistics, compare them with the partner's tracking, establish what is owed to the partner and what the partner owes affiliates, investigate differences, and keep reconciliation sheets complete and on time. If you are highly organised, strong with numbers and enjoy getting to the bottom of differences in the data, we would love to hear from you! Nous comblons le fossé entre la recherche sur ce qui fonctionne et les solutions, afin de servir efficacement des centaines de millions de personnes dans les régions les plus pauvres du monde. En l'absence de traitement efficace et rapide, la syphilis contractée pendant la grossesse comporte un risque important de mortinaissance, de décès néonatal et de handicap cognitif et physique.
